messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'hotshot-eu-01' p99 latency breach (p99=2.8s vs SLO=1.0s). Queue depth rising; warmup failures detected. Auto-scaler reports warmup_delay=34s. Details: https://redwood.internal/ops/alerts/1745551234

Alicia G: Seeing KV cache cold-paths spike too. Warmup tasks are piling. p95=680ms, p99=2.8s, streaming stalls reported by clients.

Ryan (oncall): Paging SRE. I'm on it. Initial hypothesis: burst + pool saturation + slow warmup handshake.

Maya S: Repro on staging with same model and larger seq lengths shows same warmup handshake delay. Possibly kernel selection fallback causing long init.

Ben R: Customer-facing: 2 accounts reported degraded streaming (partial transcripts missing). Queues per node > 250. Autoscaler attempted +2 nodes but warmup didn't finish before traffic landed.

Ryan (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Pause new routed traffic to hotshot-eu-01, 2) Manually scale +4 nodes, 3) Promote fallback model smaller-quantized for streaming routes.

Sam P: Copying runbook steps https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-warmup

Eli T: Manual scale command:
```
redwoodctl pools scale --pool hotshot-eu-01 --count +4 --mode manual
```
I also enabled immediate warmup concurrency:
```
redwoodctl pools config set hotshot-eu-01 --warmup-concurrency 6
```

Alicia G: I've disabled prefix caching eviction for this pool to preserve KV entries while nodes come up.

incident-bot: ACTION: manual scale +4 started by Eli T at 1745551280. Warmup jobs scheduled.

Maya S: Observing drop in queue depth from 260 -> 120 after +2 nodes, still tail at ~1.9s. Streaming stalls reduced but p99 still 1.4s.

Ryan (oncall): Routing update: diverted 30% of traffic to hosted-eu as temporary fallback. Checkpoints for critical customers only.

Ben R: Sent initial customer notice to affected accounts (private DM). ETA for full recovery unknown. Asked support to log cases under INC-1472.

Sam P: Noting impact: p95 remained within SLO but p99 breached for 18m. Customer-facing summary drafted.

Eli T: Warmup handshake fix deployed to canary (reduced kernel fallback path). Observability shows handshake path latency cut ~40%.

Maya S: After canary, warmup completed faster; autoscaler now successfully added remaining +2 nodes. Pool healthy.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: p99 back within SLO at 1745551355. Post-mitigation monitoring for 30m.

Alicia G: Postmortem notes to cover: autoscaler warmup timeout too aggressive, poor fallback routing granularity, lack of pre-warm for known scheduled bursts.

Ryan (oncall): Assigning follow-ups: - Reduce autoscaler warmup timeout (Maya), - Add pre-warm API for rapid bursts (Eng-Platform), - Customer runbook (Sam). I'll create tasks.

Ben R: :thumbsup:

Sam P: I'll schedule post-incident customer outreach and include technical appendix.

Eli T: Will add more observability metrics around warmup step durations + per-request kernel selection.

Maya S: Logging handoff to next oncall @alice (tomorrow 09:00 UTC). All set from SRE side.

Ryan (oncall): Handoff complete. Leaving notes in INC-1472. Thanks all.

Alicia G: Closing thread, will attach graphs and traces to the postmortem.

incident-bot: Playbook: Incident closed at 1745551399. Reminder: run postmortem template and mark follow-ups.
